summary: Phase 2 UI/UX Redesign — full frontend regression across all 28 scenarios in the review request. Every scenario PASSES against the preview URL (Vite dev server). Verified: (1) role→shell routing for all 5 personas (buyer→/buyer/home, supplier→/supplier/home, qc-partner→/partner/qc, procops→/ops/exceptions, admin→/admin/organizations); (2) styled permission-denied (data-testid=permission-denied, 'You don't have access to Operations' + 'Return to my workspace' link) shown for admin-only hitting /ops and buyer hitting /admin/organizations — no raw 403/JSON; (3) dual user (demo.dual) sees workspace-chooser with BOTH Buyer and Supplier for Ooty Floral Trading, WorkspaceSwitcher switches shell buyer→supplier and toast 'Now acting as Ooty Floral Trading — Supplier workspace' appears; (4) multi-org user has 3 orgs and 4 total workspace options in switcher, header updates on switch; (5) ops+admin (demo.opsadmin) chooser + switcher show BOTH 'Platform Admin' AND 'Operations' as separate options; admin-only (demo.admin) shows ONLY 'Platform Admin' (no Operations) — UX-ADR-002 upheld; (6) role-filtered ops nav: procops sees Exceptions/Sourcing/Logistics (no Finance/Claims), finance sees Exceptions/Finance (no Sourcing/Logistics/Claims); (7) buyer sidebar exactly matches spec (Home, Get flowers, Events, Offers, Orders, Deliveries, Issues, Catalog, Organization); supplier sidebar (Home, Requests, Offers, Supply, Orders, Payments, Catalog, Capabilities, Company) — no buyer/ops/admin; partner minimal (To inspect, Completed); (8) legacy redirects work: /demand/rfqs→/buyer/offers, /orders→/buyer/orders, /supply/inbox→/supplier/requests, /ops/tower→/ops/exceptions; (9) notification-bell opens SideSheet 'Notifications' with 'Nothing needs your attention' empty state (data-testid notification-feed); (10) wrong password returns styled 'Invalid email or password' error, no crash; (11) root / never shows old bounded-context tiles — always redirects to persona home; (12) responsive: 390/360/412 buyer home renders with no horizontal scroll and bottom nav with 5 links (Home/Offers/Orders/Events/More); 768 tab shows bottom nav + hidden sidebar; 1440 shows sidebar; 1920 constrains main content to 1000px (no over-stretch); (13) dirty-form switch: demo.dual on /buyer/requests/new with rose product picked + qty=15, opening switcher and clicking Supplier workspace triggers 'You have unsaved changes' modal with 'Stay here' + 'Discard & switch' buttons; (14) draft isolation confirmed — sessionStorage key `florasetu.draft.{orgId}.buyer.quick-request` includes org+workspace scope.

critical_code_review_comments: Nothing critical to flag. Shell + WorkspaceGuard + WorkspaceSwitcher + WorkspaceRouter implement the UX-ADR-001 (capability-derived eligibility) and UX-ADR-002 (PLATFORM_ADMIN alone must NOT get Operations) contracts cleanly. Testids are consistent (workspace-chooser, workspace-switcher, workspace-switcher-panel, chooser-org-*, chooser-option-<ws>-<orgId8>, switcher-org-*, switch-option-<ws>-<orgId8>, permission-denied, notification-bell, notification-feed, buyer-home, supplier-home, buyer-shell, supplier-shell, partner-shell, ops-shell, admin-shell). Dirty-check dialog copy exactly matches the spec ('You have unsaved changes' / 'Stay here' / 'Discard & switch'). Draft key naming (florasetu.draft.<orgId>.<workspace>.quick-request) correctly scopes drafts.
Consider adopting the two Router v7 future flags to silence long-standing console warnings.
test_credentials: All 9 demo personas + owner used exactly as supplied in the review request; every login succeeded.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 shell + workspace routing is fully green on preview (https://flora-modular-core.preview.emergentagent.com). Correct testid conventions: workspace-chooser (initial pick), workspace-switcher (header button opening the SideSheet), workspace-switcher-panel (the panel body). Chooser row testids are `chooser-option-<workspace>-<orgId8>`, switcher row testids are `switch-option-<workspace>-<orgId8>` — NOT the same prefix. Login testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit. To force a clean session between logins in a Playwright run, both `context.clear_cookies()` and clearing localStorage+sessionStorage are needed (auth token appears in cookie + storage). Empty notification feed is expected for all demo personas. Dirty-form dialog only fires when actually crossing to a different workspace — buyer-only users with a single workspace cannot demonstrate it (use demo.dual instead).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in Phase 2 frontend testing.
